analyst_view.overall: RB Leipzig (30th) and Lens (33rd) both have 3 points and need a win to stay in the race for the top 24. Leipzig are 4th in the Bundesliga under Martin Demichelis and won 5-1 at Union Berlin, but Castello Lukeba is out with a bruised knee (Esteve replaces him; the numbers already count him) and Ouedraogo and Guiu are still out. Lens lost 9-1 to Como last time in Europe and drew 1-1 with Toulouse in Didier Digard's first game; Gradit, Ivanovic and Bulatovic are back in the squad, while Aguilar (slight injury) and Cuisance (ill) stay home and Edouard is still out (counted). Demichelis admits 'the pressure is there' and expects a reaction from Lens. Slovak referee Ivan Kruzliak, a little below average on cards, is in the numbers.

goals.text: The numbers say 3.6 goals, adding about 8% to Leipzig for their recent scoring and about 6% to Lens for Lukeba's absence. This morning I leaned up because Gradit was out, but he and Ivanovic are back in the Lens squad, which offsets losing Aguilar and Cuisance. Nothing new points either way, so I stay at 3.6.

corners.text: The numbers say 10.4 corners, split fairly evenly, with small recent dips counted on both sides. Digard wants high full-backs and crossers on the wings, and Leipzig attack wide through Nusa and Raum, a style that tends to create corners at both ends. A mild lean from style, to about 10.6.

cards.text: The numbers say 3.3 cards, with Leipzig's quieter recent record (-8%) and Ivan Kruzliak's slightly low card rate (-5.4%) counted. A Lens side under a new coach and stung by a 9-1 defeat could play with more edge, but there is nothing concrete to size, so I stay at 3.3.

shots.text: The numbers say 28.5 shots, adding about 7% to Leipzig for their busy recent shooting and trimming Lens (-9%) for their low count. Digard's more attacking plan and Ivanovic's return could lift Lens, but without Edouard and Cuisance they have fewer creators, so these cancel out and I stay at 28.5.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 11.5 shots on target and already add about 15% to Leipzig for how often they have tested goalkeepers lately. This morning I added a little for Gradit's absence, but he is back, so I return to 11.5.
